Application Data.NAME: Elegant Upholstery Solutions
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Elegant Upholstery Solutions specializes in providing high-quality upholstery services for residential and commercial clients. We offer both in-shop and mobile services, ensuring convenience for our customers. Our trained technicians are skilled in fabric handling, repair, and cleaning, adhering to industry best practices and safety protocols. Our services include reupholstering furniture, automotive interiors, and office furnishings, catering to a diverse clientele. We maintain a secure facility with an alarm system and implement rigorous inventory tracking and quality control measures to protect customer property and ensure top-notch workmanship.
